summary: StratCap Digital Infrastructure REIT, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing that its board authorized a formal process to review and evaluate strategic alternatives to maximize stockholder value, including a sale, merger, recapitalization, orderly liquidation, or continuation of the current business plan. The board terminated the company's public offering and distribution reinvestment plan, declared it will not pay regular distributions during the review, and partially suspended its share repurchase program. An independent third-party financial advisor will assist the board; no timetable set. Watch for announcement of a specific transaction or liquidation plan; risk-arb focus on potential sale or asset monetization.
